item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Watch #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:00 AM 28 August 2026

Thunderstorm is MORE LIKELY to develop over #OccidentalMindoro, #Palawan, #NegrosOccidental, #Iloilo, #Guimaras, #Antique, #Capiz, #Aklan, #Cebu, #Bohol, #Siquijor, #NegrosOriental, #Leyte, #SouthernLeyte, #Biliran, #EasternSamar and #Samar within 12 hours.

All are advised to continue monitoring for updates.

item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #VISPRSD
Issued at 09:40 AM 28 August 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #OccidentalMindoro(Lubang, Looc, Paluan, AbraDeIlog, Mamburao, SantaCruz), #Palawan(Busuanga, Coron, Culion, ElNido, Taytay, Araceli, Dumaran, SanVicente, Roxas, PuertoPrincesaCity, Aborlan, Narra, Quezon, SofronioEspanola, Rizal and Balabac) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Palawan(Brooke'sPoint, Bataraza, Cagayancillo and Kalayaan) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
